experienceContract.childValue: A clear, non-overlapping end-of-run choice between another adventure and returning to the game world.
experienceContract.hanziLearningValue: Preserve the accepted replay ability flow without changing Hanzi content, rules, or progression.
experienceContract.automaticValidation: Responsive rectangle separation, interior hit ownership, real pointer/touch/keyboard activation, visual and ARIA baselines, and final same-tree machine gates.
experienceContract.childPlaytestValidation: A later natural real second-use may observe whether the child recognizes the choices; synthetic evidence makes no child acceptance or learning claim.

allowedMutationBoundary: affected visual/ARIA snapshot and evidence files
stopConditions: gameplay or ability semantics must change
three bounded repair loops are exhausted
a gate must be weakened to pass
